title: Pilot-scale perennial ryegrass protein extraction and finishing reference measurements
authors: Juan F. Sandoval; Jane K. Parker; Joe Gallagher; Julia Rodriguez-Garcia; Kerry Whiteside; David N. Bryant
source_locations: Table 1, row Grass juice and row Dry grass solids
Methods: Perennial ryegrass harvesting and pilot-scale processing
material_scope: Cultivated perennial ryegrass; a single 1.5 tonne pilot extraction campaign. The protein-rich material was precipitated with phosphoric acid and freeze-dried.
statistics: Table 1 values are mean ± standard error; method-section values are reported campaign values without uncertainty stated.
limitations: The feed is cultivated perennial ryegrass, not roadside grass or the GreenHub VARTA material.
No density is reported for liquid streams; volumetric observations must not be converted to mass without an explicit density source.
No titration curve or phosphoric-acid demand is reported.
The paper does not supply a complete feed-to-product protein mass balance or separator recovery curve.
Freeze-drying is not evidence for spray-dryer energy or commercial product performance.
Centrifuge operation at 21000 g is not a transferable GreenHub centrifuge design correlation.
